prompt: A four-legged forest beast with coarse green fur stands in side profile facing east on a mossy clearing, but its entire body is being drained of color: starting from its hindquarters the fur turns bone-white and chalky, then dissolves into drifting white motes and ash that scatter upward into the air, leaving the creature half-erased. The colorless white half glows faintly. The background is a deep emerald old-growth forest in full color, contrasting sharply with the bleached, vanishing animal.

A creature-shaped silhouette of pure colorless white light, in the form of a snarling wolf mid-leap, stands as an empty glowing void where an animal used to be, its edges fraying into rising white sparks as it fades out of existence. The wolf shape is featureless chalk-white, drained of all color. The background is a richly colored deep-emerald and crimson autumn forest at dusk, full of color, making the white void read as a hole punched in the world.
